description: This file contains unit tests for the ConsistentRingProvider and VirtualBucketsRingProvider classes. It verifies their behavior in various scenarios including ring range computation, silo status changes, and queue distribution. It also includes a fake implementation of ISiloStatusOracle for testing purposes.

classes.name: FakeSiloStatusOracle
classes.description: A mock implementation of ISiloStatusOracle used for testing purposes. It maintains silo statuses and allows simulating status changes.

methods.name: ConsistentRingProvider_Test1
methods.description: Tests the basic range allocation of a ConsistentRingProvider with three silos.

methods.name: ConsistentRingProvider_Test2
methods.description: Tests the ring's behavior when silos are added dynamically, checking range distribution with a VirtualBucketsRingProvider.

methods.name: ConsistentRingProvider_Test3
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive test with a large number of silos and queues to evaluate distribution and internal ranges.

methods.name: GetQueueHistogram
methods.description: Calculates the number of queues assigned to each silo and its agent ranges.
